overview: Towers: 352 apartments; earlier villa chapter: 92 homes.
research.priceNote: The developer’s Towers card advertises from AED 2.8m; its Villas card repeats that figure. Property Finder labels AED 2.9m as a launch price. A current unit-specific price and villa price basis remain unverified.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder lists 10/20/70, 10/47/43, 20/47/33, 30/47/23 and 30/70 alternatives. The table shows its first reference, not an original contractual developer calendar.
research.handoverNote: The original tower brochure forecasts Q1 2029; Property Finder corroborates. Separate villa and E/F delivery dates are unverified. The webpage’s undated 3% is not a progress certificate.
